procedure_assessments.section_heading: Section 1: Purpose, General NOC Safety & Change Control Governance
procedure_assessments.rationale: Provides overarching NOC safety invariants, OBO token authentication requirements, and CI/CD SOP slicing rules across all assurance domains.

procedure_assessments.section_heading: Section 2 (SOP-ASSUR-101): BGP Peering Session Flap Triage & Dampening
procedure_assessments.rationale: IP Core routing and eBGP route flap dampening procedure; out of scope for L2 enterprise optical access assurance.

procedure_assessments.section_heading: Section 3 (SOP-ASSUR-205): 5G RAN gNodeB Sector Outage & Tilt Reset
procedure_assessments.rationale: Mobile 5G RAN antenna electrical tilt and fronthaul procedure; unrelated to fixed enterprise Carrier Ethernet L2 circuits.

procedure_assessments.section_heading: Section 4 (SOP-ASSUR-310): Residential GPON ONT Optical Dying-Gasp Handling
procedure_assessments.rationale: Consumer mass GPON ONT power failure handling; incompatible with SLA-governed dedicated B2B enterprise fiber circuits.

procedure_assessments.section_heading: Section 5 (SOP-ASSUR-402 — TARGET): Enterprise L2 Fiber Packet-Loss Triage & Optical DDM Recalibration
procedure_assessments.rationale: Directly implements UC-001 enterprise L2 circuit packet-loss triage, optical DDM telemetry diagnosis, and governed remediation.

procedure_assessments.section_heading: Section 6 (SOP-ASSUR-509): Core DWDM Erbium-Doped Fiber Amplifier (EDFA) Pump Laser Replacement
procedure_assessments.rationale: Core DWDM optical line amplifier maintenance procedure; irrelevant to access/aggregation L2 Carrier Ethernet demarcation.

workflow_steps.description: Multi-pronged federated read querying CMDB topology, SLA entitlements, and hardware calibration envelope.
Un-cached live gNMI optical DDM telemetry probe and Redis port mutex lock acquisition.
Deterministic branch evaluation: execute autonomous TMF640 DDM recalibration or trigger TMF621 field dispatch.
Post-recalibration telemetry verification and pySHACL-validated graph resolution commit.

branch_routing.condition_summary: reported_packet_loss_pct >= 0.5 AND -27.5 <= live_rx_dbm <= -25.0 AND maintenance_lock == false
reported_packet_loss_pct < 0.5 OR maintenance_lock == true OR live_rx_dbm > -25.0

rules.description: Enforces live un-cached gNMI telemetry probing before any southbound write tool execution.
Blocks remote DDM recalibration when optical Rx power is below the hardware critical LOS cutoff (-27.5 dBm).
Blocks remote southbound state mutations during active customer maintenance freeze windows.
Enforces post-recalibration gNMI optical telemetry re-probing prior to closing incident and committing resolution triples.

architect_verification_questions: Does the pruning of distractor runbooks (SOP-ASSUR-101, 205, 310, 509) correctly isolate SOP-ASSUR-402 as the sole in-scope operational procedure for UC-001?
Does the compiled 4-step state machine correctly bind read-plane SPARQL federation and write-plane CQRS primitives strictly adhering to Option 2.1D-Catalog?
Are the machine-enforceable guardrail threshold parameters (-27.5 dBm LOS cutoff, maintenance lock, and mandatory pre/post checks) properly configured for vendor hardware model NOK-7210-SAS-Mxp?
Do the specified guardrail invariants provide deterministic 3/3 adverse scenario interception proof against cached telemetry, severe physical fiber breaks, and active maintenance windows?
